benefits.name: Smartly Earning Bonus
benefits.description: Relationship bonus that raises the earn rate on the first $10,000 in eligible net purchases each billing cycle to 2.5, 3, or 4 points per $1, depending on the cardholder's qualifying U.S. Bank deposit balance.
benefits.terms: Requires a U.S. Bank Smartly Savings account plus qualifying balances in U.S. Bank Smartly Checking and/or Safe Debit account(s). Qualifying balance is the 30-day average balance of all qualifying accounts. Tiers: $10,000-$49,999.99 = 25% bonus (2.5 points/$1); $50,000-$99,999.99 = 50% bonus (3 points/$1); $100,000+ = 100% bonus (4 points/$1). Bonus applies to a maximum of $10,000 in eligible Net Purchases each card billing cycle; purchases above that earn the base 2 points/$1.

earningRates.terms: 2 points per $1 on eligible net purchases, uncapped. Points redeem at 1 cent each (2% back) into eligible U.S. Bank deposit accounts. Balance-tiered Smartly Earning Bonus is tracked separately in benefits[].
